value.message: Village Playgroup at Children's Village of Ottawa-Carleton (333 Churchill Ave North) is a free drop-in for ages 0-5, Tuesdays 9:15-11:15am - their site says, though I could not get into their page today to confirm. EarlyON Drop-In at Blackburn Hamlet Community Centre is free, Tue and Thu 9am, Sept 8 to Dec 10 - Global Child Care Services says.
